race.comment: DEADLY FORCE (1) didn't fire on debut at Wangaratta but was sent out $1.85 there and has since spelled. He's won a jumpout leading in and is expected to improve sharply for the Shinn/Freedman combination. RAINING FIRE (5) resumes. She placed in all four runs in her maiden campaign over 1000m-1300m in some handy form races. Trained on course is always a positive here and she'll go well. TOP ACE (7) is a Turn Me Loose gelding on debut for the Douglas yard who has jumped out well here and looks ready to go. MYSTIC RIVER QUEEN (9) is a filly by Wooded for the Laurie yard who can figure first time out.
